description: This Java source file defines the class 'MonkeySourceNetworkViews' which provides utilities for performing view introspection in Android's Monkey testing framework via network commands. It includes methods for querying view properties, hierarchy, and accessibility IDs, as well as handling accessibility events and interactions.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetworkViews
classes.description: Utility class that enables Monkey to perform view introspection when issued Monkey Network Script commands over the network.

classes.name: ListViewsCommand
classes.description: Lists all view IDs for the current active window's accessibility tree.

classes.name: QueryViewCommand
classes.description: Performs various queries on a specific view identified by viewId or accessibility IDs.

classes.name: GetRootViewCommand
classes.description: Retrieves the accessibility IDs of the root view in the current window.

classes.name: GetViewsWithTextCommand
classes.description: Finds views containing specific text and returns their accessibility IDs.

classes.name: GetLocation
classes.description: Retrieves the position and size of a view in screen coordinates.

classes.name: GetText
classes.description: Retrieves the text associated with a view node.

classes.name: GetClass
classes.description: Retrieves the class name of the view node.

classes.name: GetChecked
classes.description: Gets whether the view is checked.

classes.name: GetEnabled
classes.description: Checks if the view is enabled.

classes.name: GetSelected
classes.description: Checks if the view is selected.

classes.name: SetSelected
classes.description: Sets the selected state of the view.

classes.name: GetFocused
classes.description: Checks if the view is focused.

classes.name: SetFocused
classes.description: Sets focus to or away from the view.

classes.name: GetAccessibilityIds
classes.description: Retrieves the accessibility view and window IDs for a node.

classes.name: GetParent
classes.description: Retrieves the parent node's accessibility IDs.

classes.name: GetChildren
classes.description: Lists the accessibility IDs of the child nodes.
